Description:
Lemon Dry Hash is a 60% CBD concentrate, obtained through artisanal dry sieving. The hemp trichomes are separated through an ultra-fine sieve, isolating the resin glands for a fine, sandy texture. 

 This complex technique preserves high-quality terpenes, resulting in a pure product that vaporizes and melts perfectly. With a THC level of <0.3% (compliant with French legislation), it guarantees a relaxing experience without psychoactive effects. 

 Visually clear, its neat texture and intense lemony aroma evoke fresh citrus fruits. Ideal for infusion (5-10 min with an oily substance) or vaporization, this hash delivers a vibrant flavor and an optimal entourage effect thanks to its natural compounds. Certificate of analysis available. Store in a cool, dark place.
